# LicenseHawk

> LicenseHawk specializes in IBM software and mainframe licensing optimization, audit defense, and cost reduction strategies for enterprises.

LicenseHawk helps organizations navigate complex IBM licensing landscapes, including CVA audits, ELA renewals, and mainframe contract negotiations. The company is staffed by ex-IBM auditors and ITAM experts who provide independent advisory and compliance services.

## Key Topics

- IBM Licensing
- Audit Defense
- Cost Reduction
- ILMT (IBM License Metric Tool)
- CVA (Client Value Acceleration)
- ELA (Enterprise License Agreement)
- Mainframe Licensing
- License Optimization
- Contract Negotiation
- PVU (Processor Value Unit)
- SAM (Software Asset Management)
- Compliance Risk
- Red Hat Licensing
- MLC (Mainframe License Charge)
- License Compliance
